text:
alex: Heads up, ran into a weird local testing auth bug after upgrading redwoodctl via brew. local server kept using an old org token even after switching profiles and logging out.

lee: that sounds like the cache namespacing issue we fixed last month. what's `redwoodctl version`?

alex: v0.18.1 (ugh). installer said it migrated configs. my config dir shows an "active" file that is a symlink to profiles.json.

lee: symlinked active file is part of the migration script that converts single-file state to profiles. on windows/WSL that can be flaky. can you paste `cat ~/.config/redwood/profiles.json` (just redact tokens)?

alex: sure, it has two profiles, personal and org. tokens are in credentials.json.

lee: and your local runtime? `~/.local/share/redwood/local-cache/` ?

alex: there's a cache entry named `auth-cache` with keys that look like they predate profiles.

taylor: older runtime didn't namespace cache by profile so if the active pointer got swapped (via symlink) the runtime might still read legacy keys. that explains stale tokens after logout.

alex: workarounds that worked for me: 1) `redwoodctl localtest reset-cache` (clears all local caches) 2) remove the symlink and write a plain active file with profile name 3) upgrade to latest redwoodctl (0.19.0) which has the namespaced cache.

lee: thanks. please file a tiny DX ticket to avoid symlink-migration on next installer and to add a `--profile` flag to `localtest reset-cache` so it only targets one profile.

alex: filed: DX-4721 "installer: avoid symlinking active profile during config migration; namespace local cache; add reset-cache --profile"

bugbot: Ticket DX-4721 created by alex: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/DX-4721

lee: follow-up notes: add a warning when `redwoodctl login` detects active is a symlink and refuse to overwrite without explicit `--force`. also log which cache keys are used in `localtest` debug logs so users can see profile key mappings.

alex: filed a short PR with repro steps and commands I ran. happy to help test the fix. thanks for the quick help! :thumbsup:
